title: The Throne That Traveled in an Instant
intro: A figure of immense authority ruled over a wealthy kingdom blessed with riches beyond measure. When an unexpected challenge arose, this ruler faced a trial not of swords but of wisdom and faith. What unfolded would lead from the pinnacle of worldly power to a profound transformation of heart.
clues: I ruled over a kingdom blessed with riches and prosperity beyond imagination
I was a powerful monarch who received a bold letter demanding submission
My nobles counseled me about whether to fight or make peace with this far-off king
I set out with magnificent gifts to meet this distant king myself
My royal throne was brought to a far-off land in the blink of an eye, before I could return
When I entered a palace with a floor smooth as glass, I finally proclaimed my submission to Allah

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
